headline: P0088 (Family Practice, GA): 99215 share well above complexity-adjusted expectation, with the largest relative excess on low-complexity patients
rationale: P0088 billed 99215 on 26.5% of 1,169 claims, against an expected 5.7% given its patients' complexity (z vs peers 3.23, risk-adjusted score 11.30). The panel does include sicker patients, but that does not explain the excess. The provider's 99215 share is above the all-provider share in every complexity stratum, and the gap is widest where acuity is lowest: 9.3% vs 2.1% for patients with 0 chronic conditions and 15.8% vs 3.4% for patients with 1 (about 4.5x). For patients with 5+ conditions it is 42.5% vs 29.8% (about 1.4x). In the sampled low-complexity 99215 claims, many carry only a single routine or symptom code: C0044545 (Z09 follow-up, 0 conditions), C0044789 and C0044898 (R10.9 only), C0045278 (R21 only), C0045451 (M54.50, age 18), C0045616 (E78.5, age 27). The same patient was sometimes billed at different levels for similar codes, for example N0457 (C0045575 at 99215 vs C0044988 at 99214) and N0013 (C0044746 at 99215 vs C0045237 at 99214). Sampled high-complexity 99215 claims (e.g. C0045426, C0045587) look plausible. These are random samples, and no clinical documentation, time, or MDM records are in the packet, so this is a pattern consistent with upcoding, not a finding of improper billing.
next_steps: Request medical records for the sampled 99215 claims on 0-1 condition patients (e.g. C0044545, C0044789, C0045278, C0045451) and check the documented MDM or total time against 99215 requirements.
Compare documentation for the same-patient level differences (C0045575 vs C0044988; C0044746 vs C0045237) to see what justified the higher level.
Pull a larger, stratified sample of low-complexity 99215 claims to confirm the excess shown in the stratum table.
Check whether 99215 claims rely on time-based coding, and whether the documented times are plausible given daily claim volume.
Review the provider's 2024 billing trend and any template or EHR default that could be driving 99214/99215 selection.
